covers: Public web consent UI, optional analytics/marketing vendors, and privacy-choice persistence
invariants: Analytics and Marketing are denied until the visitor explicitly chooses them.
The authentication/session storage model is not the consent mechanism.
Purchase conversion events require Marketing consent.
On the homepage, the first-visit banner waits until the Help Me Choose flow closes.

implementation.state: src/lib/consent.ts stores versioned choices in the esim2you_consent first-party cookie for 180 days.
implementation.ui: src/app/ConsentManager.tsx renders the first-visit modal, detailed switches, and the persistent footer Privacy choices control.
implementation.vendors: src/app/GoogleTag.tsx gates Google Ads and optional GA4; src/app/MetaPixel.tsx gates Meta Pixel.
implementation.legal: src/content/legal.ts describes necessary, analytics, and marketing categories and the withdrawal path.
